params.baseline_path: sentient_style: whole vault (600 KB cap) + 5 raw samples x 6 recent contacts + 15 recent emails + raw thread; text only (no screenshot, generous to the baseline)
params.judge: model: the same model as the drafts (qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)), pairwise, both orders (Nugget as A then as B), JSON verdict {voice, factuality, winner}, thread/context/drafts fenced as untrusted
params.model: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.nugget_path: in_suite: nugget_draft::classify (contract rules) + nugget-retrieve (text-only, recency boost, sensitive items excluded for cloud) + voice-stats prompt (nugget_voice::VoiceHints/StyleStats computed in-suite) + instruction neutralising
params.voice_metric: in_suite stylometric distance (bench/src/suites/draft/style.rs); switches to nugget_voice::style_distance when it lands

metrics.name: draft.nugget.voice_match

metrics.name: draft.baseline.truncated_tasks
metrics.description: Tasks whose Sentient-style whole-vault prompt was cut to fit the model's context window (vault tail first, then the oldest writing samples; thread kept)
